Campaign notes:
- Four angles are approved: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Send window is consistently 10am.
- No deliverability complaints reported; two unsubscribes were received via support on Day 1 and processed.
- List growth occurred on several days, but its cause is unknown.
- Recent mix favored B and D; A and C have not been selected in the recorded period.
- Results are pooled and do not identify performance by day or angle. Day 5 report: 3 of the last 5 pushes landed (+0.60). Day 10 report: 2 of the last 5 landed (+0.40). Do not infer that B or D caused either result.
- Continue controlled angle testing and seek per-angle/per-day reporting before declaring a winner.

Campaign notes:
- Four angles approved and legally cleared: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Standard send window remains 10am.
- No deliverability complaints reported. Support processed two unsubscribes on Days 1, 11, 12, and 19; these do not establish an angle-related issue.
- List growth occurred on several days, including Days 15 and 18, but its cause remains unknown.
- Earlier mix favored B and D, but Days 11–16, 18–19 used A; C was used on Day 17. A is now heavily represented, while C has limited recent coverage.
- Results are pooled and provide no per-day or per-angle attribution. Do not infer that A, B, C, or D caused any reported result.
- Day 5: 3 of last 5 pushes landed (+0.60). Day 10: 2 of last 5 (+0.40). Day 15: 5 of last 5 (+1.00). Day 20: 3 of last 5 (+0.60). These are aggregate windows, not angle-specific outcomes.
- Continue controlled testing, prioritizing balanced coverage (especially C, and B/D as needed), while avoiding claims about winners until per-angle/per-day reporting is available.

Campaign notes:
- Four angles approved and legally cleared: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Standard send window remains 10am.
- No deliverability complaints reported. Support processed two unsubscribes on Days 1, 11, 12, and 19; these do not establish an angle-related issue.
- List growth occurred on several days, including Day 26; cause remains unknown.
- Days 11–16 and 18–19 used A; Day 17 used C. Days 21–30 also used C exclusively, so C is now heavily represented and is no longer the under-covered angle. Rebalance future testing toward A, B, and D.
- Day 25 included refreshed banner art, a potential confound; do not attribute its result to C.
- Results remain pooled with no per-day or per-angle attribution. Do not infer that any angle caused a reported result or is outperforming others.
- Aggregate reports: Day 5, 3/5 landed (+0.60); Day 10, 2/5 (+0.40); Day 15, 5/5 (+1.00); Day 20, 3/5 (+0.60); Day 25, 3/5 (+0.60); Day 30, 2/5 (+0.40). These are rolling windows, not angle-specific outcomes.
- Continue controlled, balanced testing. Record send date, angle, creative changes, list changes, and per-angle/per-day performance when available. Avoid winner claims until attribution data exists.

Campaign notes:
- Four angles approved and legally cleared: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Standard send window remains 10am. No deliverability complaints reported.
- Days 31–34 used B; Day 35–39 used D; Day 40 used B. Continue balancing tests across A, B, and D; C is already heavily represented and should not be prioritized solely to fill coverage.
- Day 31 and Day 35 had list growth; record it as a potential confound without attributing it to an angle.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 34 and 37; treat both as creative confounds and do not attribute results to B or D.
- Rolling report for Day 35: 1/5 landed (+0.20). Rolling report for Day 40: 1/5 landed (+0.20). These provide no per-day or per-angle attribution and must not support winner claims.
- Earlier aggregate reports remain rolling windows, not angle-specific outcomes: Day 5 3/5 (+0.60), Day 10 2/5 (+0.40), Day 15 5/5 (+1.00), Day 20 3/5 (+0.60), Day 25 3/5 (+0.60), Day 30 2/5 (+0.40).
- Continue controlled, balanced testing. Log send date, angle, creative changes, list changes, deliverability observations, and per-day/per-angle performance when available. Avoid causal or performance claims until attribution data exists.

Campaign notes:
- Four angles are legally cleared: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Standard send window remains 10am. No deliverability complaints reported.
- Days 41–50 all used A. Do not interpret the repeated selection or reported outcomes as evidence that A wins.
- Balance future testing across A, B, and D; after the A-heavy run, prioritize B or D for the next controlled sends. C is already heavily represented and should not be chosen solely to fill coverage.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 34, 37, 45, 46, 47, 48, and 50. Treat these as creative confounds; do not attribute associated results to the angle.
- The list grew on Days 31, 35, and 49. Record growth as a confound without attributing effects to an angle.
- Day 45 and Day 50 reports each state 1/5 landed (+0.20), but both are rolling-window results with no per-day or per-angle breakdown. They cannot support winner claims.
- Earlier aggregate reports remain rolling windows, not angle-specific: Day 5 3/5, Day 10 2/5, Day 15 5/5, Day 20 3/5, Day 25 3/5, Day 30 2/5, Day 35 1/5, Day 40 1/5.
- Continue controlled, balanced testing. Log send date, angle, creative and list changes, deliverability observations, and attributable per-day/per-angle performance. Avoid causal or performance conclusions until valid attribution data exists.

Campaign notes:
- Four angles remain legally cleared: A price cut, B quality story, C limited-time urgency, D customer testimonial.
- Standard send window remains 10am. No deliverability complaints reported; Day 58 specifically had none.
- Days 41–50 were all A; Days 52–54 and 56–59 were B-heavy. Do not treat selection frequency or reported outcomes as evidence of angle performance.
- Day 51 used D, Day 55 used D, and Day 60 used B. Continue controlled, balanced testing; after the A- and B-heavy runs, prioritize D or A for upcoming controlled sends. C is already heavily represented and should not be selected solely for coverage.
- List growth occurred on Days 31, 35, 49, 52, 54, and 57. Treat each as a confound, not an angle effect.
- Support-reported unsubscribes occurred on Days 51, 53, and 59. Processed unsubscribes are audience signals, not angle-attributable performance.
- Legal reaffirmed approval for all angles on Days 55, 56, and 60; this is not performance evidence.
- Day 55 reported 1/5 landed (+0.20), and Day 60 reported 2/5 (+0.40). Both are rolling-window results with no per-day or per-angle breakdown and cannot support winner claims.
- Earlier aggregate reports remain rolling windows, not angle-specific: Day 5 3/5, Day 10 2/5, Day 15 5/5, Day 20 3/5, Day 25 3/5, Day 30 2/5, Day 35 1/5, Day 40 1/5.
- Log send date, angle, creative/list changes, deliverability observations, and attributable per-day/per-angle results. Avoid causal or performance conclusions until valid attribution data exists.
